description:
## Finding
\`git ls-files target/ | wc -l\` reports 26,943 tracked files under \`target/\` even though \`.gitignore\` includes \`/target/\` and \`*.rlib\`. The branch is 96 commits ahead of origin/main and \`git status\` always shows modified rlib files because every workspace build rewrites them.

## Why P0
- Persistent working-tree dirtiness obscures real changes during review (this entire review had to ignore \`target/.rustc_info.json\` and 11 modified rlibs).
- Repo bloat: tens of thousands of compiled artifacts in history.
- Merge conflicts in compiled artifacts on every cross-branch operation.
- Future operators cannot reproduce builds because compiled artifacts are out of sync with source after any rustc/dep version change.

## Reproduction
\`\`\`
\$ git ls-files target/ | wc -l
26943
\$ git status | head
modified:   target/.rustc_info.json
modified:   target/debug/libpkix_ac.rlib
... (all 11 crate rlibs)
\`\`\`

## Fix
1. \`git rm -r --cached target/\` and commit
2. Verify \`/target/\` line in \`.gitignore\` is honored
3. Same treatment may be needed for the gitignored-but-stray \`rust_out\` binary in repo root

## Scope reference
Workspace root, \`.gitignore\`, all of \`target/\`.
title: P0: 26,943 build artifacts under target/ tracked in git despite .gitignore
